verb: stalk, pounce and pin, sabre stab, forepaw swipe
look: massive sabre-toothed cat with two long ivory sabre canines, a dark grey-black shaggy mane over neck and shoulders, white-grey fur with bold black tiger stripes, glowing pale blue eyes, a long striped tail with a black tip, heavy clawed paws; the alpha is brown-maned and tawny with umber mottling
texture_prompt: white and pale grey fur with bold black tiger stripes, dark grey-black mane, black tail tip, ivory sabres, glowing pale blue eyes, matte fur

clips.idle: Breathing, slow look round, tail sway
clips.walk: Lateral-sequence cat walk, heel peels off the toes
clips.run: Rotary gallop with the back flexing
clips.stalk: Low hunting creep: body flat, head low and level, slow placed steps (approach)
clips.attack_primary: Forepaw swipe: rises on the left fore, right paw rakes down and across (hit from the paw)
clips.attack_heavy: Pounce windup: sinks into a flat crouch, rump wiggles, jaws gape, then springs into a sabre lunge
clips.pounce: Launches from the crouch, forelegs reaching, slams both paws on the prey and stabs
clips.pin_stab: Holds the prey under both forepaws, rears the head with jaws wide and drives the sabres down twice
clips.hit_react: Flinches back off the forepaws, head jerks away, snarls
clips.knockdown: Big cat is thrown onto its side
clips.alert: Rises on the forelegs and roars, jaws wide, head shaking
clips.feed: Head down on the carcass, jaws tearing, a yank back
clips.sleep: Lies down on its belly, forepaws out, chin low, tail curled

size_note: # ASSUMPTION (SP-SMILODON): height_meters 2.0 is the top of the mane and ears (shoulder ~1.6 m, length nose to tail tip ~3.5 m on screen, the house 1.6x of a ~2.2 m long-tailed smilodon); real_length_m 4.4 is the roster's 2x convention (was 2.5). The owner's sheet draws it about twice the survivor's height at the shoulder; if he wants that, height_meters ~3.4.

pipeline.mesh: Tripo P1 multiview (front, left, back, right), task aad4a28f-718f-4e91-ad56-27300a8e3246, 50 Tripo credits (task credits_consumed 50; shared balance 2505 before, 2355 after, other species agents ran at the same time)
pipeline.reference_sheet: game/assets/creatures/smilodon/ref/smilodon_sheet.png (owner sheet 1, regular) and smilodon_alpha_sheet.png (owner sheet 2, alpha); the four Tripo views were drawn by Codex from sheet 1 in a neutral standing pose (left), front (tail hidden) and back; right = left mirrored
pipeline.legs: tools/gait/smilodon_rig.py: digitigrade cat legs (hip/shoulder -> knee/elbow -> hock/wrist, Foot = metatarsus+paw to the toe tips), leg skin re-weighted geometrically, the paw rigid on Foot
pipeline.jaw: tools/jaw/add_jaw.py --pivot 0.03 0.393 --split -6 --chin-depth 0.35 --blend 0.008; tools/gait/smilodon_sabres.py keeps the sabre islands rigid on Head
pipeline.gaits: tools/gait/make_gait.py tools/gait/smilodon.json: walk, run (rotary gallop), stalk; strafe_left/right and walk_back from the walk plan (stride 0.3)

clips_from.attack_primary,attack_heavy,pounce,pin_s: tools/gait/make_cat_moves.py (keyed from rest, IK feet, floor pass)
clips_from.knockdown,death: the Triceratops donor transplant, moved onto the cat legs (transfer_clips.py)

pipeline.grounding: tools/gait/ground_clip.py on knockdown, death and the gaits
pipeline.hit_parts_note: SP-SMILODON: each hit also needs its part (Creature.part_hit): the swipe the right forepaw, the lunge, pounce and pin stabs the sabres on Head; # ASSUMPTION radii (metres at size 1, plus the target's radius)
pipeline.variant_note: alpha = the owner's brown-maned sheet as a recolour of the regular albedo (tools/gait/smilodon_alpha_skin.py); Creature.spawn gives it to alphas only, regular animals keep the GLB as authored

eyes._note: SP-SMILODON: the owner's glowing pale blue eyes; points = the painted eyes (Blender +-0.037, -0.449, 0.466 mesh units) in Head bone space
